lyrics:
[Intro: pounding piano chords, handclaps, crowd chant]
La, la-la-la, la
La, la-la-la, la

[Verse 1: male rap, very fast, stomping kick]
Alright, alright, coffee in the cup and my boots laced up
Twenty years of "almost" and I'm done with giving up
Had a dream in a shoebox, had a plan in a drawer
Had a landlord and a doubt and both were knocking at the door
I was good, never great, I was close, never there
I was polishing a résumé for jobs I didn't care for
Then my kid said "Dad, why don't you do the thing you do?"
And I didn't have an answer, so I'm answering it now

[Chorus: soul tenor, slow and huge over the fast beat]
Tonight the ceiling's just a floor
For somebody who wanted more
So climb, so climb
On every shoulder in the room
We're going through
Tonight the ceiling's just a floor

[Verse 2: male rap, even faster, trumpet stabs]
Used to count up everybody who was younger and ahead
Used to lie awake rehearsing all the clever things they said
Now I'm counting up the people in the kitchen when I'm home
Got a table full of reasons and I didn't build alone
Shout out to the neighbour with the ladder and the van
To the teacher who said "maybe" when the others said "you can't"
To the late ones, the stubborn ones, the second-time-arounds
Put your hands on someone's shoulders, get your feet up off the ground

[Chorus: soul tenor, slow and huge over the fast beat]
Tonight the ceiling's just a floor
For somebody who wanted more
So climb, so climb
On every shoulder in the room
We're going through
Tonight the ceiling's just a floor

[Chant: crowd alone with claps and kick, trumpet melody]
La, la-la-la, la
La, la-la-la, la
La, la-la-la, la
La, la-la-la, la

[Bridge: half-time, tenor ad-libs, choir builds]
Lift me, I'll lift you
Lift me, I'll lift you
All the way through

[Final Chorus: full choir, trumpet, piano hammering]
Tonight the ceiling's just a floor
For somebody who wanted more
So climb, so climb
On every shoulder in the room
We're going through
Tonight the ceiling's just a floor

[Outro: chant and claps, one piano chord]
La, la-la-la, la
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 146 BPM, 4/4, E minor. A sprinting, stomping, hand-clapping drive. Breathless and joyful.

VOICE: A male rapper with a clear, bright voice delivering dense verses at high speed without slurring. A male soul tenor with a big, churchy voice who sings the chorus in long notes across the fast beat. A crowd chanting a wordless line. A choir in the bridge and final chorus.

INSTRUMENTS: An upright-sounding piano hammering chords on the beat. Handclaps on the off-beats. A stomping kick drum and a marching snare. A solo trumpet playing a bright fanfare. Deep bass. Strings in the chorus. A whistling synth line.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, piano, claps and the chant. 0:13 Verse 1, eight fast lines. 0:39 Chorus 1. 1:05 Verse 2, with trumpet stabs. 1:31 Chorus 2. 1:57 Chant, the crowd with claps, kick and trumpet. 2:23 Bridge, half time, building with the choir. 2:49 Final chorus with everything. 3:15 Outro, chant and claps, a last piano chord at 3:35.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Early-2010s independent hip-hop with a live, hand-made sound: real piano, real claps, a big room, vocals bright and forward.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The tenor's first long note at 0:39, slowing the song down while the beat keeps running.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The rapper is not a young man on the way up. He is twenty years in, and verse 2 is a list of the people who lifted him. The title turns personal ambition into a relay.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Frustration, a child's question, gratitude, lift-off.
